test_valid_subset_error_raising: test that raise_if_valid_subsets_unintentionally_ignored raises ValueError when valid subsets are unintentionally ignored
test_legal_valid_subset_configs: test that legal valid subset configurations like --combine-val and --ignore-unused-valid-subsets do not raise errors
test_disable_validation_flag: test that the --disable-validation flag allows any valid subset file combination without raising errors
test_combine_valid_subsets: test that --combine-valid-subsets merges validation metrics from multiple subsets into combined output
test_separate_valid_subset_metrics: test that --valid-subset produces separate per-subset metrics like valid_ppl and valid1_ppl
